conviction_note: Q3 is new (no pre-release), released in session around 15:00 CET on 13 Nov. Counterparty reads are mildly positive: Parker's Jul-Sep organic growth was +9.4% in North America and +4% in EMEA with orders accelerating, Bucher Hydraulics' implied Q3 orders were about +8%, and Water-Jetting faces an easy comp. Against that, a +9.65% 20-day run-up and an Intermonte preview already expecting organic acceleration have lifted the bar, and the name has sold 'in line' prints before (Q1 2026 -9.1%), so p_up is only 55 on a 5% abs move. impact_sum +0.65 and impact_scaled +0.5 agree in sign and are about the same size.

already_public.what: FY2026 guide: organic revenue -2% to +3%, 'more confident on the upper part'; EBITDA margin 22-22.5%; record FCF; acquisitions add ~2.5% of sales (H1 organic +0.7%)

Management on the Q2 call: H2 Hydraulics growth positive but lower, Water-Jetting positive, book-to-bill above 1 in both divisions in H1, July sales trend 'a clear support' for the FY guide, Q4 dip not expected to repeat
Intermonte/Websim preview: Q3 expected to confirm a strengthening recovery with organic growth accelerating (numbers behind paywall)
Termination, at the company's sole initiative, of an executive with strategic responsibilities (Ing. Riccardo Mastronardi), with a clarification published at CONSOB's request

new_in_release.expect: Q3 organic growth turns positive and accelerates against a weak Q3 2025 base (Water-Jetting -2.3%, Far East -34%; North America Hydraulics -10.3%); revenue roughly EUR 525-535m against 499.2m; modest upside

FY organic guide most likely reiterated at the upper end, with a possible narrowing to roughly +2/+3%. Margin guide 22-22.5% reiterated; the risk is a Q4 caution remark, as Q4 disappointed in each of the last three years
9M FCF and net financial position. Management guides a record FCF; H1 FCF was EUR 94.6m against 76.0m. Mildly positive
Unknown: the M&A pipeline, and any explanation of the October executive departure

bar: Company guide (FY organic upper part of -2%/+3%, EBITDA margin 22-22.5%; https://www.interpumpgroup.it/sites/default/files/documents/ip_2q2026_financial_results_reports_5_august_2026.pdf) and Intermonte's qualitative 'organic acceleration' preview (https://www.websim.it/azioni/analisi-fondamentale-italia/interpump-risultati-3q-attesa-accelerazione-della-crescita-organica/). No numeric Q3 consensus could be sourced, so the quarter-level bar is unsourced and the findings are capped small.
session_check: bmo. The release comes in session, around 15:00 CET, so it falls inside close(2026-11-12) -> close(2026-11-13). The Q3 2025 release was disseminated on 14 Nov 2025 at 15:00:25 per eMarket STORAGE (https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2025-11/20251114_174477.pdf). Q2 2026 was on the Teleborsa wire at 15:12 on 5 Aug 2026 (https://www.teleborsa.it/AMP/News/2026/08/05/interpump-ricavi-1-1percent-ed-ebitda-2-8percent-nel-secondo-trimestre-159.html) and Q1 2026 at 15:23 on 15 May. The 13 Nov 2026 board date comes from the company calendar as reported by https://www.orafinanza.it/it/azioni-interpump-calendario-finanziario. Only about 2.5 hours of trading follow the release, and part of the reaction has historically carried into the next day (Aug 2025 +3.4% then +8.2%; May 2026 -9.1% then +4.4%).
positioning_check: The CONSOB posizioni nette corte register was read as of 2026-11-11 (https://www.consob.it/documents/11973/395154/PncPubbl.xlsx/fbefe0a2-795b-bad3-9369-beccbeb14f27) and does not name Interpump. That is a 0.0 at the 0.5% truncation floor, not a measurement (anchor_covered false). The change is 0.0 on that same truncated basis. In practice there is no positioning anchor, and priced_lean_pct (-0.48) is the run-up term.

findings.finding: Bucher Hydraulics, a direct mobile-hydraulics peer, implies Q3 2026 order intake of CHF 165m against 153m (+7.8% reported) and Q3 sales of CHF 166m against 156m (+6.4%). That is 9M orders 502 vs 474 minus H1 orders 337 vs 321, and 9M sales 497 vs 475 minus H1 sales 331 vs 319. Construction hydraulics are growing, but Bucher says 'a slowdown in orders for the agricultural machinery segment was noticeable recently'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Hydraulics organic growth drove the Aug 2025 print (+3.4% on the day, +8.2% the next) and the Aug 2026 print (+4.05%). The Q1 2026 print fell 9.1% despite Hydraulics growth, on margin.
findings.why_not_priced: Bucher released it on 27 Oct, and Interpump has risen from 36.6 to 39.5 since, so it is partly priced. The Q3 split is not printed; it has to be derived from 9M minus H1 (the H1 base is in https://www.marktpuls.ch/artikel/permalink/674352). If it were fully in the price, the Intermonte preview would carry a number rather than a direction. The agricultural caveat (Walvoil exposure) cuts against it, so the size is small.
findings.independence: Parker Hannifin FQ1 (separate company, separate document), finding 2: https://finviz.com/news/416828/parker-delivers-record-fiscal-2027-first-quarter-results-raises-full-year-outlook

findings.finding: Parker Hannifin's quarter ended 30 Sep 2026 shows Diversified Industrial North America organic growth of +9.4% ('growth across all market verticals') and International organic growth of +11.6% (EMEA +4%). Rolling 12-month orders accelerated to +11% NA (from +9%) and +14% International (from +10%). Interpump's North America Hydraulics fell 10.3% in Q3 2025, so its comp is easy.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: North America was the weak region in Q3 2025 (-8.5% group); the stock fell 1.24% on that print despite a 22% EPS beat on Yahoo's numbers.
findings.why_not_priced: Parker is a broad industrial proxy, not Interpump's own number. Interpump rose 0.7% on 5 Nov and 2.5% on 11 Nov, so the read-through is partly in the +9.65% 20-day run-up. It is sized small because the transmission is an inference.

findings.finding: Water-Jetting faces a weak Q3 2025 comp: division revenue 169.2m (-2.3%), with Far East at 23.7m against 36.1m (-34.4%). The company said book-to-bill stayed above 1 in H1 in both divisions (1.15 in Q1 for Water-Jetting, slightly lower in Q2), so the higher-margin division (26% EBITDA margin against about 21% for Hydraulics) should return to growth and ease the mix headwind on margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Mix-driven margin decline was the theme of the Q1 2026 drop (-9.06%) and was looked through in Q2 2026 (+4.05%).
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: management told the market on 5 Aug that H2 would be 'more balanced', and Kepler modelled mid-single-digit Water organic growth on the call. It falls inside the company's own guide, so it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: The company's Q2 2026 call (a separate document, same issuer): https://www.interpumpgroup.it/sites/default/files/documents/ip_2026_2q_transcript.pdf

findings.finding: On 5 Oct 2026 Interpump ended the employment of Ing. Riccardo Mastronardi, an executive with strategic responsibilities. At CONSOB's request it then clarified that this was at the company's sole initiative and that no non-compete or settlement agreement exists. The stock fell 2.9% and 2.4% on 7-8 Oct, and the Q3 release or call may be the first place it is explained.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance in this window. The drawdown on 7-8 Oct was fully recovered by late October.
findings.original_quote: la cessazione del rapporto di lavoro con l'Ing. Riccardo Mastronardi è stata intrapresa ad esclusiva iniziativa della Società, e che allo stato non sussistono patti di non concorrenza e/o accordi transattivi (the termination was undertaken at the sole initiative of the Company, and at present there are no non-compete and/or settlement agreements)
findings.why_not_priced: The fact is public and the stock has recovered it, so what remains is only the risk of an unwelcome explanation on the call. It is sized small for that reason. If it were material to the quarter, it would have come with a price-sensitive guidance filing, and none exists on eMarket STORAGE between 6 Aug and 12 Nov.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management flagged higher energy and transport costs tied to the Middle East situation, and said 'some CAPEX is being postponed in the region'. It offset them with price increases and surcharges. Energy is still high into the print: TTF gas at about EUR 90.8/MWh and oil at $86 on 12 Nov on the Borsa Italiana Teleborsa wire. This is a margin risk against the 22-22.5% guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin compression drove the Q1 2026 drop (-9.06%, EBITDA margin 21.9% against 22.5%).
findings.why_not_priced: The macro is visible to everyone, and the company said it is passing costs through. Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis, so this is sized small.

baseline_tension: The mildly positive peer reads agree with the +9.65% 20-day run-up rather than cutting against it, so the findings are largely what the run-up already priced. The priced lean (-0.48) is the run-up term alone, with no register anchor.
language_note: eMarket STORAGE (Italian) carried the CONSOB-requested clarification that the executive's exit was 'ad esclusiva iniziativa della Società' with no settlement agreement; the English search returned only the bare departure
The Italian regulated filings and the Teleborsa wire gave the exact dissemination times (15:00:25, 15:12, 15:23 CET) that settled the in-session release; no English source carried them
The Italian Q3 2025 release gave the regional and divisional comp table (Settore Acqua Far East -34.4%, Olio North America -10.3%) that sizes the easy comp
lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move' and 'size the move on what is new': abs_move_pct raised from 4.5 to 5.0. The quarter is not pre-released, a guide fine-tune is possible, and the name's own in-session prints reach -9%. It is not raised to the full 7% European base because only about 2.5 hours of trading follow a 15:00 release.
'A finding inside what the company already guided is worth little': the Water-Jetting comp finding cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
'A narrow proxy and macro transmission are hypotheses': Parker cut from +0.5 to +0.4 and the energy finding from -0.2 to -0.15. Bucher, a direct counterparty, is held at +0.4.
'The reaction history vetoes the direction, not the size': p_up held at 55 rather than raised, because Q1 2026 was sold -9% on an 'in line' print and the run-up has lifted the bar.
